about: The brand-only Risperdal fills on 8 March and 5 April 2026 each supply 30 days at two tablets daily and together cover more than 42 continuous days.
Zyprexa Zydis (olanzapine) 15 mg, one wafer at night, which is above 10 mg a day, is supplied four times from January 2026 to April 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
The May risperidone supply covers 28 days, and the pharmacist confirms that the separate oral course restarted in August lasted 42 days or fewer without a break.
Four fortnightly Risperdal Consta supplies provide 56 continuous days as prescribed, and any one of the four supply lines may be cited.
Both supplies prescribe Zyprexa Relprevv 300 mg every 2 weeks, which corresponds to an oral target above 10 mg daily in either phase.
Possible finding: the first supply is Zyprexa Relprevv 405 mg every 4 weeks and the record does not say whether this is the starting or maintenance phase.
Two Risperdal Consta kits provide 28 days and the later Zyprexa Relprevv maintenance dose of 300 mg every 4 weeks corresponds to an oral target of exactly 10 mg daily.
Two regular oral olanzapine strengths supplied together provide 10 mg each night and 5 mg each morning, for a total of 15 mg daily.
Zyprexa Relprevv 300 mg every 4 weeks alone gives no finding when the phase is unstated.
Zyprexa Relprevv at its maintenance target of 10 mg daily and regular oral olanzapine 5 mg daily cover the same 28 days, bringing the total to 15 mg daily.
